name: "The Century of Gehry"
description: A stunning retrospective on the work of influential architect Frank Gehry, whose visionary designs have reshaped skylines and imaginations worldwide.
longDescription:
"The Century of Gehry" is an art exhibition presented at the Serralves Museum of Contemporary Art, dedicated to the architectural legacy of Frank Gehry. This retrospective explores the career of the Canadian-American architect, known for his distinctive deconstructivist style and the impact of his designs on global urban landscapes. The exhibition aims to provide insight into the evolution of his work, from early projects to his most recognized structures.

Visitors to Serralves can expect to engage with a collection of models, drawings, and photographic documentation spanning Gehry's extensive career. The exhibition is housed within the museum's galleries, offering a contemplative environment for viewing the architectural displays. The content is suitable for individuals with an interest in architecture, design, and contemporary art.

The exhibition runs from September 3rd to September 9th, 2026. Serralves Museum is accessible via bus lines 201, 203, 207, and 504, with stops located near the museum entrance. Parking facilities are also available on-site.
